name: Zhejiang Zone-King Environmental Sci&Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zone-King Environmental Sci&Tech Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive array of services focused on environmental management and protection. Their expertise spans various ecological solutions, including the remediation of contaminated groundwater, mitigation of water pollution, restoration of aquatic ecosystems, purification of gaseous emissions, and treatment of solid waste, among other specialized offerings. This company, established in 2003, maintains its primary operational base in Hangzhou, China.
